dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: What? You think that just because I'm old I'm gonna stay in the shelter with the others and wait for everything to be fixed?

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Hmph, in your dreams! If I can still crack fish skulls with a hammer, then I still have the strength to work.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: Besides, now is when technical consultants are most needed. They'd best not think about sending me packing.
